newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks lower at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks lower at start.

text.p: The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down in early trading on Tuesday, falling prey to profit-taking after Monday's rally took it to the first record close in nearly two months.
The Dow Industrials was off 12 at 7,203 points while the Nasdaq Composite fell six at 1,333.
The 30-year long bond wasoff 15/32 to yield 6.92 percent.
